definition.en: The cervical nerves are the spinal nerves from the cervical vertebrae. Although there are seven cervical vertebrae (C1-C7), there are eight cervical nerves (C1-C8). (In the other portions of the spine, the nerve emerges below the vertebra with the same name. Dorsal (posterior) distribution includes the greater occipital (C2) and third occipital (C3). Ventral (anterior) distribution includes the cervical plexus (C1-C4) and brachial plexus (C5-C8) [WP,unvetted].

The Rectus femoris muscle is one of the four quadriceps muscles of the human body. (The others are the vastus medialis, the vastus intermedius, and the vastus lateralis. All four combine to form the quadriceps tendon, which inserts into the patella and continues as the patellar ligament. ) The Rectus femoris is situated in the middle of the front of the thigh; it is fusiform in shape, and its superficial fibers are arranged in a bipenniform manner, the deep fibers running straight down to the deep aponeurosis. A blood vessel that supplies oxygenated blood to the lateral structures of the thorax and breast. It originates from the axillary artery and follows the lower border of the Pectoralis minor muscle to the side of the chest, supplies the serratus ventralis muscle and the Pectoralis major muscle, and sends branches across the axilla to the axillary lymph nodes and Subscapularis muscle. It anastomoses with the internal thoracic artery, subscapular, and intercostal arteries, and with the pectoral branch of the thoracoacromial artery. In the female it supplies an external mammary branch which turns round the free edge of the Pectoralis major and supplies the breasts. [WP,unvetted].

The truncus arteriosus and bulbus cordis are divided by the aorticopulmonary septum. The truncus arteriosus gives rise to the ascending aorta and the pulmonary trunk. The bulbus cordis gives rise to the smooth parts (outflow tract) of the left and right ventricles.
definition.es: El tronco arterioso y el bulbo cardíaco están divididos por el tabique aorticopulmonar. El tronco arterioso da origen a la aorta ascendente y al tronco pulmonar. El bulbo cardíaco da origen a las partes lisas (tracto de salida) de los ventrículos izquierdo y derecho.

A membrane inside the cochlea of the inner ear. It separates scala media from scala vestibuli. Together with the basilar membrane it creates a compartment in the cochlea filled with endolymph, which is important for the function of the organ of Corti. It primarily functions as a diffusion barrier, allowing nutrients to travel from the perilymph to the endolymph of the membranous labyrinth. Histologically, the membrane is composed of two layers of flattened epithelium, separated by a basal lamina. Its structure suggests that its function is transport of fluid and electrolytes.
definition.es: Membrana situada dentro de la cóclea del oído interno. Separa la rampa media de la rampa vestibular. Junto con la membrana basilar, crea en la cóclea un compartimento lleno de endolinfa, que es importante para la función del órgano de Corti. Actúa principalmente como barrera de difusión, permitiendo que los nutrientes pasen de la perilinfa a la endolinfa del laberinto membranoso. Histológicamente, la membrana está compuesta por dos capas de epitelio aplanado, separadas por una lámina basal. Su estructura sugiere que su función es el transporte de líquido y electrolitos.

definition.en: The posterior auricular vein begins upon the side of the head, in a plexus which communicates with the tributaries of the occipital vein and superficial temporal veins. It descends behind the auricula, and joins the posterior division of the posterior facial vein to form the external jugular. It receive the stylomastoid vein, and some tributaries from the cranial surface of the auricula.
definition.es: La vena auricular posterior comienza en el lado de la cabeza, en un plexo que se comunica con los afluentes de la vena occipital y de las venas temporales superficiales. Desciende por detrás de la oreja y se une a la división posterior de la vena facial posterior para formar la yugular externa. Recibe la vena estilomastoidea y algunos afluentes de la cara craneal de la oreja.

definition.en: The lingual veins begin on the dorsum, sides, and under surface of the tongue, and, passing backward along the course of the lingual artery, end in the internal jugular vein. The vena comitans of the hypoglossal nerve (ranine vein), a branch of considerable size, begins below the tip of the tongue, and may join the lingual; generally, however, it passes backward on the Hyoglossus, and joins the common facial.
An adventitia that is part of a epididymis.

The foramen secundum is an opening in the septum primum, a precursor to the interatrial septum of the human heart. It is formed at a later developmental stage than the foramen primum. Its location is also different relative to the site of the foramen primum in the septum primum.
definition.es: El foramen secundum es una abertura del septum primum, precursor del tabique interatrial del corazón humano. Se forma en una etapa del desarrollo posterior a la del foramen primum. Su ubicación también es diferente respecto a la del foramen primum en el septum primum.

definition.en: A small fold of mucous membrane extending from the floor of the mouth to the midline of the underside of the tongue.

A fiber pathway that originates from neurons in the posterior hypothalamic region and projects to various nuclei of the anterior nuclear group of the thalamus. It is a composite structure that consists of the mammillothalamic tract of the hypothalamus and the mammillothalamic tract of the thalamus (Carpenter-1983). (from Brain Info.org).
The handle of the malleus; the portion that extends downward, inward, and backward from the neck of the malleus; it is embedded throughout its length in the tympanic membrane.

definition.en: During the third week there appears, immediately behind the ventral ends of the two halves of the mandibular arch, a rounded swelling named the tuberculum impar, which was described by His as undergoing enlargement to form the buccal part of the tongue. More recent researches, however, show that this part of the tongue is mainly, if not entirely, developed from a pair of lateral swellings (or distal tongue bud) which rise from the inner surface of the mandibular arch and meet in the middle line.

The medial border of the scapula (vertebral border, medial margin) is the longest of the three borders, and extends from the medial to the inferior angle. It is arched, intermediate in thickness between the superior and the axillary borders, and the portion of it above the spine forms an obtuse angle with the part below. This border presents an anterior and a posterior lip, and an intermediate narrow area. The anterior lip affords attachment to the Serratus anterior; the posterior lip, to the Supraspinatus above the spine, the Infraspinatus below; the area between the two lips, to the Levator scapulC& above the triangular surface at the commencement of the spine, to the Rhomboideus minor on the edge of that surface, and to the Rhomboideus major below it; this last is attached by means of a fibrous arch, connected above to the lower part of the triangular surface at the base of the spine, and below to the lower part of the border.
A tunica intima that is part of a vein.
A nucleus embedded within the fibers of the trapezoid body.

definition.en: A subdivision of a limb or fin skeleton consisting of bones which connects the upper limb or fin to the axial skeleton on each side. It consists of the clavicle and scapula in humans and, in those species with three bones in the pectoral girdle, the coracoid. Some mammalian species (e.g. the dog and the horse) have only the scapula. In humans, the only joints between the shoulder girdle and axial skeleton are the sternoclavicular joints on each side. No joint exists between each scapula and the rib cage; instead the muscular connection between the two permits relatively great mobility of the shoulder girdle in relation to the pelvic girdle. In those species having only the scapula, no joint exists between the forelimb and the thorax, the only attachment being muscular[WP]. Examples: There are only two instances, right and left pectoral girdle skeletons.

definition.en: The Procerus is a small pyramidal slip of muscle deep to the superior orbital nerve, artery and vein.
definition.es: El prócer es un pequeño fascículo muscular piramidal situado en profundidad respecto al nervio, la arteria y la vena orbitarios superiores.

synonymsEn: nerve root part of lumbar spinal cord

definition.en: A spinal nerve root that is part of a lumbar nerve.
One of a number of vertical folds, produced by an infolding of the mucous membrane and some of the muscular tissue in the upper half of the lumen of the anal canal[WP].
An intrinsic circulatory network that transports hormones from the median eminence of the hypothalamus to the adenohypophysis.
A series of crescentic folds of mucous membrane somewhat spirally arranged on the interior of the gallbladder and continuing into the cystic duct.
Mesenchyme that is part of a pharyngeal arch 6.

A smooth, rounded eminence on the lateral portion of the articular surface of the humerus. It articulates with the cupshaped depression on the head of the radius, and is limited to the front and lower part of the bone.
The eighth thoracic vertebra counting from the top down. Note that members of this class are not necessarily homologous[ncit,modified].
definition.es: La octava vértebra torácica contando de arriba abajo. Nótese que los miembros de esta clase no son necesariamente homólogos[ncit,modified].

definition.en: Subdivision of the skeletal system which consists of the appendicular skeleton plus associated joints.
A zone of skin that is part of a prepuce of clitoris.

The pubococcygeus muscle or PC muscle is a hammock-like muscle, found in both sexes, that stretches from the pubic bone to the coccyx (tail bone) forming the floor of the pelvic cavity and supporting the pelvic organs. It is part of the levator ani group of muscles.
definition.es: El músculo pubococcígeo o músculo PC es un músculo en forma de hamaca, presente en ambos sexos, que se extiende desde el hueso pubiano hasta el cóccix (hueso de la cola), forma el suelo de la cavidad pélvica y sostiene los órganos pélvicos. Forma parte del grupo de músculos elevadores del ano.

synonymsEn: vagus X nerve left recurrent laryngeal branch

definition.en: Connective tissue, which consists of a population of connective tissue cells, the intercellular matrix of which contains an irregular network of collagen and elastic fiber bundles. Examples: areolar tissue, mucoid tissue, connective tissue of peritoneum, connective tissue of fibrous pericardium.
Nerve fibers which project from cell bodies of autonomic ganglia to synapses on target organs.
definition.es: Fibras nerviosas que se proyectan desde los cuerpos celulares de los ganglios autónomos hasta sinapsis en los órganos diana.

definition.en: A hepatic vein that is part of a left lobe of liver.
definition.es: Vena hepática que forma parte de un lóbulo hepático izquierdo.

definition.en: A skeletal joint that connects a radius bone and connects a carpal skeleton.

External opening or orifice of the urethra through which urine and seminal fluid (in males only) leave the body; in males the meatus presents as a vertical slit normally positioned at the tip of glans penis; in females the meatus is located between the clitoris and the vagina in the vulvular vestibule of the female genitalia[MP].
A muscle layer that is part of an intestine.

synonymsEn: visceral peritoneum of fundus of stomach

definition.en: A serous membrane that is part of a fundus of stomach.

On the upper surface of the cerebellum the vermis is elevated above the level of the hemispheres, but on the under surface it is sunk almost out of sight in the bottom of a deep depression between them; this depression is called the vallecula of the cerebellum, and lodges the posterior part of the medulla oblongata.
The secretory unit of a serous gland. The acinar portion is composed of serous secreting cells.
An epithelium that is part of a intestinal villus.
A nipple that is in_the_right_side_of a body proper.
definition.es: Pezón que se encuentra en el lado derecho del cuerpo propiamente dicho.

definition.en: The inferior pubic ramus is thin and flattened. It passes lateralward and downward from the medial end of the superior ramus; it becomes narrower as it descends and joins with the inferior ramus of the ischium below the obturator foramen.
definition.es: La rama inferior del pubis es delgada y aplanada. Se dirige lateralmente y hacia abajo desde el extremo medial de la rama superior; se estrecha a medida que desciende y se une con la rama inferior del isquion por debajo del agujero obturado.

definition.en: The ischiopubic ramus is a compound structure consisting of the following two structures: from the pubis, the inferior pubic ramus from the ischium, the inferior ramus of the ischium It serves as part of the origin for the Obturator internus muscle. It also marks a vertex of the anal triangle and the urogenital triangle. The fascia of Colles is attached to its margin.
definition.es: La rama isquiopubiana es una estructura compuesta formada por las dos estructuras siguientes: del pubis, la rama inferior del pubis; del isquion, la rama inferior del isquion. Sirve como parte del origen del músculo obturador interno. También marca un vértice del triángulo anal y del triángulo urogenital. La fascia de Colles se inserta en su borde.

UBERON:0014541.labelEs: porción torácica del conducto central de la médula espinal

definition.en: Part of spinal cord central canal contained in the thoracic spinal cord. It is continuous rostrally with the cervical spinal cord central canal and caudally with the lumbar spinal cord central canal.
definition.es: Parte del conducto central de la médula espinal contenida en la médula espinal torácica. Es continua rostralmente con el conducto central de la médula espinal cervical y caudalmente con el conducto central de la médula espinal lumbar.

isA.labelEn: subdivision of spinal cord central canal

distal interphalangeal joint of manual digit II

definition.en: The angular vein formed by the junction of the frontal vein and supraorbital vein, runs obliquely downward, on the side of the root of the nose, to the level of the lower margin of the orbit, where it becomes the anterior facial vein. It receives the external nasal veins of the ala nasi, and communicates with the superior ophthalmic vein through the nasofrontal vein, thus establishing an important anastomosis between the anterior facial vein and the cavernous sinus.
definition.es: La vena angular, formada por la unión de la vena frontal y la vena supraorbitaria, desciende oblicuamente, junto al lado de la raíz de la nariz, hasta el nivel del borde inferior de la órbita, donde se convierte en la vena facial anterior. Recibe las venas nasales externas del ala de la nariz y se comunica con la vena oftálmica superior a través de la vena nasofrontal, estableciendo así una importante anastomosis entre la vena facial anterior y el seno cavernoso.

synonymsEn: lateral palpebral branch of ophthalmic artery

definition.en: The lateral palpebral arteries are small arteries which supply the eyelid.
definition.es: Las arterias palpebrales laterales son pequeñas arterias que irrigan el párpado.

synonymsEn: cortex of lobe of cerebral hemisphere

definition.en: Grey matter neocortex region of a lobe of the cerebral hemisphere.
A white matter of cerebral lobe that is part of a limbic lobe.
The Extensor pollicis brevis lies on the medial side of, and is closely connected with, the Abductor pollicis longus.

Regional part of telencephalon lying on the basal surface and bounded by the olfactory trigone rostrally, the diagonal band medially and caudally and the prepiriform cortex laterally. It is characterized by many perforations caused by small blood vessels entering the gray matter (Meyer et al., J. Comp. Neurol 284: 405, 1989).
A branch of the superior mesenteric artery that supplies the jejunum.
A lower primary incisor tooth that is in_the_lateral_side_of a dentition.
definition.es: Incisivo temporal inferior que está en el lado lateral de una dentición.

definition.en: An embryonic or larval epithelium that is committed to form part of the nervous system.

The deep temporal arteries, two in number, anterior and posterior, ascend between the Temporalis and the pericranium. They supply the muscle, and anastomose with the middle temporal artery. The anterior communicates with the lacrimal artery by means of small branches which perforate the zygomatic bone and great wing of the sphenoid.
definition.es: Las arterias temporales profundas, dos, anterior y posterior, ascienden entre el temporal y el pericráneo. Irrigan el músculo y se anastomosan con la arteria temporal media. La anterior se comunica con la arteria lagrimal mediante pequeñas ramas que perforan el hueso cigomático y el ala mayor del esfenoides.

definition.en: The line of junction between the processes of the maxilla and the horizontal parts of the palatine bones that form the hard palate.
definition.es: Línea de unión entre las apófisis del maxilar y las láminas horizontales de los huesos palatinos que forman el paladar duro.

definition.en: A pointed projection at the front extremity of the intermaxillary suture.
definition.es: Proyección puntiaguda situada en el extremo anterior de la sutura intermaxilar.

definition.en: A branch of the common peroneal nerve. It innervates the ankle and toes.
The aspect of the kidney facing the abdominal cavity.
definition.es: Cara del riñón orientada hacia la cavidad abdominal.

definition.en: Muscular components of the deep perineal pouch.
definition.es: Componentes musculares del espacio perineal profundo.

definition.en: Artery that runs from left to right along the greater curvature of the stomach, between the layers of the greater omentum, and anastomoses with the right gastroepiploic.
definition.es: Arteria que discurre de izquierda a derecha a lo largo de la curvatura mayor del estómago, entre las hojas del omento mayor, y se anastomosa con la gastroomental derecha.

definition.en: The mostly sharp edge of the orbital opening that is the peripheral border of the base of the pyramidal orbit.
definition.es: Borde, en su mayor parte agudo, de la abertura orbitaria que constituye el límite periférico de la base de la órbita piramidal.

definition.en: The zygomaticotemporal nerve or zygomaticotemporal branch (temporal branch) is derived from the maxillary branch of the trigeminal nerve (Cranial nerve V). It runs along the lateral wall of the orbit in a groove in the zygomatic bone, receives a branch of communication from the lacrimal, and passes through zygomaticotemporal foramen in the zygomatic bone to enter the temporal fossa. It ascends between the bone, and substance of the Temporalis muscle, pierces the temporal fascia about 2.5 cm. above the zygomatic arch, and is distributed to the skin of the side of the forehead, and communicates with the facial nerve and with the auriculotemporal branch of the mandibular nerve. As it pierces the temporal fascia, it gives off a slender twig, which runs between the two layers of the fascia to the lateral angle of the orbit.
definition.es: El nervio cigomaticotemporal o ramo cigomaticotemporal (ramo temporal) deriva del ramo maxilar del nervio trigémino (nervio craneal V). Discurre a lo largo de la pared lateral de la órbita por un surco del hueso cigomático, recibe un ramo comunicante del lagrimal y atraviesa el agujero cigomaticotemporal del hueso cigomático para entrar en la fosa temporal. Asciende entre el hueso y la sustancia del músculo temporal, perfora la fascia temporal unos 2,5 cm por encima del arco cigomático y se distribuye a la piel del lado de la frente, y se comunica con el nervio facial y con el ramo auriculotemporal del nervio mandibular. Al perforar la fascia temporal, emite una ramita delgada que discurre entre las dos capas de la fascia hasta el ángulo lateral de la órbita.

definition.en: Intestinal lymph node located anterior to aorta.
definition.es: Nódulo linfático intestinal situado por delante de la aorta.

UBERON:0038796.labelEs: nódulo linfático a lo largo del conducto colédoco

definition.en: The superior laryngeal vein is a vein which drains the larynx into the superior thyroid vein.

The conus artery is generally considered to be the first branch of the right coronary artery (RCA) in the right sinus of Valsalva. However, one study has shown that in approximately 50% of humans, the conus artery arises from a discrete ostium in the right sinus of Valsalva.
definition.es: La arteria del cono se considera generalmente la primera rama de la arteria coronaria derecha (ACD) en el seno de Valsalva derecho. Sin embargo, un estudio ha demostrado que en aproximadamente el 50 % de los seres humanos la arteria del cono surge de un ostium independiente en el seno de Valsalva derecho.

synonymsEn: fifth intercostal branch of internal thoracic artery
zone of skin of adult scalp

definition.en: A zone of skin that is part of a scalp.
definition.es: Zona de piel que forma parte de un cuero cabelludo.

definition.en: A lymph node located inferior to the ilium.
definition.es: Nódulo linfático situado inferiormente al ilion.

definition.en: A wall of the urinary bladder that is situated on the sides or flanks.
A vein that is tributary of the angular vein and drains blood from the superficial tissues and skin of the dorsum (bridge) and ala (wings) of the nose.
definition.es: Vena que es afluente de la vena angular y drena la sangre de los tejidos superficiales y la piel del dorso (puente) y del ala (aletas) de la nariz.

definition.en: An artery that branches from the axilliary artery and supplies the deltoid, biceps brachii, and coracobrachialis muscles, the glenohumeral joint, the proximal humeral head, and the skin overlying the anterior aspect of the proximal humerus. This artery courses laterally across the anterior surface of the humerus and anastomoses with the posterior humeral circumflex artery.
An anatomical cavity that is part of the alveolus of the lung
definition.es: Cavidad anatómica que forma parte del alvéolo del pulmón.

definition.en: A vein that is a tributary of the superior ophthalmic vein and drains blood from the ciliary body of the eye.

A zone of the lens cortex that lies immediately beneath the lens capsule and epithelium and surrounds the inner cortex of lens. It is composed of the most recently differentiated lens fibre cells, added from the lens epithelium at the equator; it contains the remodelling and transition zones in which fibre cells lose their nuclei.
definition.es: Zona de la corteza del cristalino situada inmediatamente por debajo de la cápsula y el epitelio del cristalino y que rodea la corteza interna del cristalino. Está compuesta por las células fibrosas del cristalino de diferenciación más reciente, añadidas desde el epitelio del cristalino en el ecuador; contiene las zonas de remodelación y de transición en las que las células fibrosas pierden sus núcleos.
